The build process creates a Python virtual environment, activates it, and installs dependencies from `requirements.in` instead of a pinned `requirements.txt`. While using an unpinned dependency file can introduce variability in build dependencies, this is not inherently malicious—it reflects a practical workaround when upstream does not maintain up-to-date lock files. The build script (`build.py`) is executed from the cloned repository, which is expected behavior. No obfuscated code, network exfiltration, or unauthorized downloads are present.

All installed files are fonts and license data placed in standard system directories. The package provides both OTF and TTF variants under appropriate subpackages, with correct licensing and conflict declarations. The actions are confined to building and installing the font files as expected. There is no evidence of supply-chain attacks or malicious behavior.
</details>
